name: University of Birmingham
description: Founded in 1900 on the vision set down by politician and statesman Joseph Chamberlain, the University of Birmingham prides itself on a longstanding tradition of innovation and progressive initiatives. The university was a founding member of the National Union of Students, and the first in the country to be built on a campus model, incorporate a medical school and offer degrees in dentistry. University of Birmingham is 87th in QS World University Rankings 2021, maintaining its position in the top 100 universities globally and placing the University as 13th amongst UK universities.
